{
  "evidence": [
    {
      "quote": "This circular provides guidance to management companies of funds that are authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong (Funds)6 in this regard.",
      "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u4.564"
    },
    {
      "quote": "6 Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs).",
      "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"
    },
    {
      "quote": "A Fund classified as a complex product will be subject to the SFC’s prevailing requirements for the sale of complex products8 including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.",
      "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"
    }
  ],
  "frame_assumptions": [
    "Both assessments must concern the identical fund F, as a whole distributed product, at the identical assessment instant t. Neither individual holdings, intermediary funds, investors nor transactions are separate threshold units.",
    "The SFC in both frames is the same authorising and designating institution. Managers, distributors and investors retain their distinct roles; their actions are not substitutes for an SFC designation. Home regulators appear expressly only in the left frame, as contextual inputs to SFC discretion, not as alternative designation authorities.",
    "Both frames must use the same private-market asset category: private credit and private equity. The right frame's explicit TRS and SRT examples fall within the left frame's financial-derivative category only insofar as they provide relevant private-market exposure. Neither list limits the indirect-exposure universe.",
    "Both frames must distinguish underlying private-market assets from intermediary holdings and instruments. Their direct and indirect components must be determined by the same established methodology, including look-through, derivatives, netting, layered holdings and prevention of inappropriate double counting.",
    "Both frames must express each exposure component and fund NAV in the same exact valuation unit U at t. No currency, scale, valuation convention or rounding equivalence is inferred from the labels 'valuation units' and 'accounting units'. The identity mapping is conditional on exact normalization to U.",
    "Authorisation, LAF category and designation applicability must concern F at t. The left category fact is interpreted contemporaneously with the other facts, consistently with its assessment frame.",
    "Positive NAV is a shared model-domain premise, not an additional legal rule established by the quoted circular. Outside the shared scope, neither model supplies a classification answer.",
    "No effective date, measurement frequency, averaging window, temporary-crossing treatment, cure period or automatic declassification rule is established here. Document-update timing is distinct from classification timing.",
    "Offering documents, manager communications and home-regulator conditions remain contextual distinctions. Their omission from one frame's object list does not eliminate their possible legal relevance, but neither formal predicate directly tests them.",
    "This proposal establishes neither these premises nor legal equivalence. Referenced but unavailable instruments may impose additional classification and distribution requirements.",
    "The required output enum cannot faithfully encode the supplied TRUE_IS_SATISFIED classification predicates. The TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT entries below are schema-constrained placeholders only; they are not assertions of compliance. A faithful executable semantic bridge requires an output convention that represents classification satisfaction."
  ],
  "left_frame": {
    "actors": [
      "SFC: authorises F and may make an applicable case-specific designation.",
      "Fund manager: reviews classification and communicates with distributors.",
      "Distributors: distribute F subject to applicable sale requirements.",
      "Investors: recipients of distribution.",
      "Home regulators: may impose conditions informing SFC discretion."
    ],
    "objects": [
      "The assessed fund F as a whole.",
      "F's direct private-credit and private-equity exposure.",
      "F's indirect exposure through intermediary holdings and instruments, including BDCs, CLOs and financial derivatives.",
      "Underlying private-market assets, distinct from intermediary instruments.",
      "F's NAV.",
      "An actual SFC designation applicable to F.",
      "Strategy, composition, liquidity, risks, asset characteristics and home-regulator conditions informing discretion."
    ],
    "temporal_basis": "One identified distribution assessment instant t, with contemporaneous exposures and NAV and a designation applicable then; the retained text does not establish assessment cadence or crossing treatment.",
    "unit_of_assessment": "The entire fund F at t, aggregating its relevant direct and indirect private-market exposures."
  },
  "left_schema_hash": "50f59aace1868a5bdd2e4e34aafe06ef1320b8ca6a447f742cf356b1cf007953",
  "mapping": {
    "assumptions": [
      "All common facts are indexed by the fixed fund F and assessment instant t specified in the frame premises. Common integer amounts use the exact common unit U and the same established measurement methodology.",
      "Identity expressions below apply only after the frame premises have been independently established. Equal variable names or similar descriptions do not establish equal measured quantities.",
      "The shared scope becomes (and common_authorised (not common_laf) (> common_nav (integer 0))). A false scope gives no classification answer, including for an excluded LAF.",
      "Within shared scope, both result expressions reduce by associativity of exact integer addition to (or (>= (+ (+ common_direct common_indirect) (+ common_direct common_indirect)) common_nav) common_designation). This preserves the inclusive 50% boundary without division or rounding.",
      "The arithmetic comparison concerns total direct plus indirect exposure, not the separate 15% direct-investment limit. It uses the assessed fund's NAV, not the NAV of a BDC or another intermediary.",
      "An applicable or operative designation means the same actual SFC institutional act concerning F and effective at t. Risk factors, enhanced scrutiny, home-regulator restrictions and manager opinions alone do not establish common_designation.",
      "Unknown facts remain unknown rather than becoming false or zero. With scope established, either independently established true result branch can establish classification; a false result requires both branches to be established false.",
      "False means neither modeled classification basis is present on established facts at t. It does not establish non-complex status under other rules or prevent a later designation.",
      "Both supplied statements label true as TRUE_IS_SATISFIED. Neither permitted output enum accurately describes that meaning: complex classification is neither a prohibition nor a compliance finding. TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT is used solely as a required serialization placeholder on both sides, with no semantic endorsement. Consequently this is a conditional fact-and-predicate proposal, not a validated output-label bridge.",
      "Source quotes support the classification structure and categories, but do not establish actual fund facts, the measurement methodology, temporal premises or legal equivalence."
    ],
    "common_facts": [
      {
        "meaning": "The fixed assessed fund F is authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong at the fixed assessment instant t.",
        "name": "common_authorised",
        "requires_judgment": false,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u4.564"
        ],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "Boolean for F at t"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "F belongs at t to the listed closed-ended alternative asset fund category excluded by footnote 6; this is a category determination, not a non-complex classification.",
        "name": "common_laf",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"
        ],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "Boolean fund-category determination for F at t"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "Aggregate direct exposure of F to private credit and private equity at t, determined under the shared established measurement methodology, separately from the indirect component.",
        "name": "common_direct",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u1.5",
          "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
        ],
        "type": "integer",
        "unit": "Exact common valuation unit U, identical for both exposure components and F's NAV"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "Aggregate indirect exposure of F to private credit and private equity at t through all relevant intermediary holdings and instruments, including qualifying BDC, CLO, TRS and SRT exposures and other qualifying channels, under the shared methodology. Underlying assets remain distinct from intermediaries; aggregation avoids inappropriate double counting.",
        "name": "common_indirect",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u1.5",
          "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779",
          "d4148dd852cee.u59.7979",
          "d4148dd852cee.u62.8487"
        ],
        "type": "integer",
        "unit": "Exact common valuation unit U, identical for both exposure components and F's NAV"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "Total net asset value of F at t under the shared valuation basis; it is the assessed fund's denominator, not an intermediary's NAV.",
        "name": "common_nav",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779",
          "d4148dd852cee.u58.7778"
        ],
        "type": "integer",
        "unit": "Exact common valuation unit U, identical for both exposure components and F's NAV"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "The SFC has actually made a case-specific complex-product designation concerning F that applies and is operative at t. Potential grounds for designation do not suffice; missing evidence does not establish false.",
        "name": "common_designation",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": [
          "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779",
          "d4148dd852cee.u29.4630",
          "d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"
        ],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "Boolean for an SFC decision concerning F and operative at t"
      }
    ],
    "evidence": [
      {
        "quote": "The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has observed that investment funds may, for asset allocation and yield enhancement purposes, gain exposure to private credit and private equity (collectively, private market assets) via: direct exposure through investments in bank or non-bank direct lending in the form of loans or equities to unlisted companies (direct exposure)1; or indirect exposures2 including through investments in business development companies (BDCs)3, collateralised loan obligations (CLOs)4 or financial derivative instruments5.",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u1.5"
      },
      {
        "quote": "A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV. On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"
      },
      {
        "quote": "In assessing whether the complex product designation is warranted7, the SFC will adopt a holistic approach taking into account the specific circumstances of the case.",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u29.4630"
      },
      {
        "quote": "7 In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"
      },
      {
        "quote": "2 The examples of indirect exposures set out in paragraph 1 above are non-exhaustive, and subject to review and update by the SFC from time to time in view of market developments.",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u59.7979"
      },
      {
        "quote": "5 For example, Total Return Swaps on indices with exposure to leveraged loans or broadly syndicated loans (TRSs), or Significant Risk Transfers with underlying assets that are corporate loans (SRTs).",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u62.8487"
      },
      {
        "quote": "1 Direct investments in/exposures to private assets fall within the investment limit of 15% of a Fund’s total net asset value (NAV) under 7.3 of the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds (UT Code).",
        "unit_id": "d4148dd852cee.u58.7778"
      }
    ],
    "left": {
      "applicable_sfc_designation": "common_designation",
      "direct_exposure": "common_direct",
      "indirect_exposure": "common_indirect",
      "is_laf": "common_laf",
      "nav": "common_nav",
      "sfc_authorised_public_fund": "common_authorised"
    },
    "left_commitment": "ad3ed6f7c586444ec7213491691980dde1de00675aff2f8415163372e6e85bdf",
    "left_output": "TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT",
    "right": {

    },
    "right_commitment": "e0f879754935c6d04e666dfa292f253ce2817d74cd625823a88b77b0e34e75df",
    "right_output": "TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT",

  },

    ],
    "temporal_basis": "The same specified distribution assessment instant t, with contemporaneous comparable exposures and NAV and a designation operative then; no effective date, averaging window, reassessment cadence or automatic declassification rule is supplied.",
    "unit_of_assessment": "The entire fund F as a distributed product at t; individual holdings and investor transactions are not separate threshold units."
  },
